newsitem.title: USA: Monsanto says Holden's deal passes U.S. review.
newsitem.headline: Monsanto says Holden's deal passes U.S. review.

text.p: Monsanto Co said Monday it received notice that the U.S. Department of Justice completed its Hart-Scott-Rodino review of Monsanto's acquisition of Holden's Foundation Seeds Inc, Corn States Hybrid Service Inc and Corn States International.
Monsanto said it is proceeding to close the acquisitions. In January, Monsanto announced separate agreements to acquire the companies for a total cost of up to $1.02 billion.
Holden's is a foundation seed corn company, which develops germ plasm. Corn States and Corn States International are the exclusive worldwide marketing and sales representatives for Holden's products.

"Holden's and Corn States are critical to our life sciences strategy," Hendrik Verfaillie, executive vice president of Monsanto, said in a statement. "We expect them to play a key role in the global introduction of new products created through biotechnology that improve crop performance, enhance food quality and offer health benefits." ((--Reuters Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
